text.en:
The compensation Schedule for the Career Executive Service, as provided in Section 1 of
Presidential Decree No. 847, is hereby revised as follows:
"a. COMPENSATION SCHEDULE
(Annual Rates)
"RankGrade 1Grade 2Grade 3Grade 4
"b. POSITIONS COVERED
"The various ranks in the Career Executive Service cover the following positions, and such other positions as
may be determined to be of equivalent category by the Career Executive Service Board:
Rank IDeputy Minister
Rank IIAssistant Secretary Bureau Director Regional Director (Department-wide Regionalization)
Rank IIIAssistant Bureau Director Assistant Regional Director (Department-wide Regionalization)
Rank IVRegional Director (Bureau-wide Regionalization) Ministry Service Chief

Rank VAssistant Regional Director (Bureau-wide Regionalization)

The amount of P13.5 M or so much as may be necessary to implement the revised rates of
compensation is hereby appropriated out of funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated. In case
of deficiency, savings in the appropriations of the respective offices and agencies may be utilized for this

The Minister of the Budget and the Career Executive Service Board shall promulgate the rules
and regulations for the implementation of this Decree.

Any and all laws, decrees, executive orders, rules and regulations or parts thereof which are
inconsistent with this Decree are hereby repealed and/or modified accordingly.

This Decree shall take effect on July 1, 1978.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 11th day of June, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-eight.
